name: Vilitch the Curseling
canonNotes: Born a despised, frail runt, Vilitch prayed to Tzeentch to reverse his fate with his athletic twin Thomin; their bodies melded, and Thomin became a drooling puppet under his command.
His magic grew a hundredfold, and he took vengeance on all who had looked down on him.
voiceNotes: Clever, scheming and resentful; speaks in calculated half-truths.
Contempt for the brutish and for those who pity him.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
